metadata.title: Examples of absolutely minimal polyhedral chains in maximum norm spaces
metadata.abstract: We construct explicit area-minimizing polyhedral disks in $\R^n$ with the maximum norm for $n=2,3,4$. Their boundaries are polygonal images of the geodesic circle of length $2\pi$, obtained from $n$ distance functions. Piecewise constant calibrations show that these disks minimize mass among Ambrosio--Kirchheim metric currents with the same boundary. The example for $n=4$ gives the lower bound $11\pi^2/20\approx5.42828$ for Gromov's filling area conjecture. For $n>4$, finite linear programs provide further lower bounds.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 显式构造与最优性证书
analysis.workSummary: 在最大范数空间中构造绝对面积极小的多面体圆盘，并用于 Gromov 填充面积问题的下界。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出二维至四维的显式极小链；四维构造产生 11π²/20 的下界，更高维提供可计算的线性规划下界。
analysis.limitations: 极小性是相同边界的度量流比较；该下界不等于解决整个填充面积猜想。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者说明三、四维圆盘及校准先由本人猜测、SciPy 和线性规划实验发现；ChatGPT 随后用于改写表述与论证、核对计算参考文献并制作图，不能将原始构造归给 AI。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.29593v1 · PDF 第 19 页 Origin of the examples and use of AI
